note: Huron NF near Glennie (Alcona Co.), small rustic drive-in campground (~5-vehicle capacity) on the Pine River, popular in fishing season; bring your own water. CCC-built picnic shelter (mid-1940s). Hunting, mushroom gathering and berry picking nearby. Not on recreation.gov. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-06-04, 'Site Open'): $10 single (confirmed), first-come only (confirmed; no recreation.gov listing), vault toilets, no potable water (confirmed, derived -> manual), season April 12 - November 30 (opens new, closes confirmed), senior/access 50% (now stated). Huron Shores Ranger Station (989) 739-0728 matches. No forest alert or order names the campground or its road (the March 2026 Huron Zone storm alert lists only trails). FS silent on sites, length and hookups. Note trimmed of field restatements.
